additional_context: The motivating Zulip thread records the Patient.name earliest-component behavior and orderMeaning discussion. FHIR-I minutes on 2022-08-29 record reopening the earlier resolution and approving the Persuasive with Modification discretion approach 14-0-0. No conflicting later Jira, Zulip, Confluence, or source-history evidence was found during this bounded reconciliation.
reconciliation: No source edit was made. The active search narrative already states that servers have discretion for sorting repeated and complex elements, including examples for Patient.name family/given/prefix ordering and multiple given names using either earliest sort value or first instance value.
